data.ruling: The refutation stands as a correction to the figure. It is not a finding against the part. The requirement list for Cell monitor cites IOBoard.md:475 for its "quantities" entry but copies only half of that row. The row sets per-cell voltage and per-cell resistance under load, and also per-pack capacity and drawn mAh, all marked "required". The list names only the per-cell items. That makes it an incomplete statement of the function's requirements, and so of its cited source. The list already counts a quantity that comes partly from another part: per-cell resistance uses the INA228's motor current. The per-pack items belong in the list on the same terms. Fix: extend the quantities entry to "per cell: voltage, and resistance under load (from the voltage and the INA228's motor current); per pack: capacity (the SET_PACK_MAH setting, 0 to 30,000 mAh) and drawn mAh (the INA228AIDGSR's 40-bit CHARGE register, in coulombs, reset by RSTACC; mAh = C / 3.6)". Adding this item does not change ADBMS1818ASWAZ-RL's pass. The cell monitor IC measures no current. Drawn charge comes from the INA228AIDGSR, an owner-fixed R8 input. Capacity is a setting, not a measurement. No link register carries either per-pack value yet (IOBoard.md:433). The verifier's other checks on the list (V181 to V195, V289, V324, V327, V7) are not in dispute and are not ruled on here. One minor correction to the verifier's evidence: the re-rank does not list the per-pack quantities as a separate function with an empty list. It records them in its report as the figure "Cell monitor quantities (P3 missed function)" and adds no part. This does not affect the ruling.
data.evidence: IOBoard.md:475 at 7e74cd442a79 reads "| Cell monitor quantities | per cell: voltage, and resistance under load. Per pack: capacity and drawn mAh | `shared/ui/include/battery_screen.h:13-20` | required |". shared/ui/include/battery_screen.h:13-20: battery_state_t has volts[] (per cell), milliohms[] (per cell, under load), capacity_mah and drawn_mah. The refuted list's "quantities" entry gives only "per-cell voltage; resistance under load from the voltage and the INA228's motor current", with source "IOBoard.md:475; IOBoard.md:74". No other entry names capacity or drawn mAh. shared/settings/settings.c:42-44: SET_PACK_MAH is "pack_mah", "Capacity", an integer from 0 to 30000 mAh in steps of 100, default 5000. INA228 data sheet SLYS021A, revised May 2022: register Ah is CHARGE, 40 bits, "Calculated charge output. Output value is in Coulombs. Two's complement" (section 7.6.1.11, Table 7-15). Equation 7 is Charge [C] = CURRENT_LSB x CHARGE. Setting RSTACC (CONFIG bit 14) clears CHARGE. CHARGEOF flags an overflow. IOBoard.md:433: no link register carries the battery screen's capacity or drawn charge. The FU-2J R9 re-rank (scratch/FU-2J/rerank-R9/final.json, report figure "Cell monitor quantities (P3 missed function)") assigns the per-pack quantities to the INA228 and the setting and adds no R9 part.
